title.en: The abundant but expensive energy source that's under your feet
title.zh: 脚下蕴藏的丰富但昂贵的能源

summary.en: Start-up companies are exploring new methods to harness geothermal energy, an abundant power source found beneath the earth's surface. The primary challenge for these ventures lies in making the economics of extraction and utilization viable.
summary.zh: 初创公司正在探索利用地热能的新方法，这是一种蕴藏在地表之下、储量丰富的能源。这些企业面临的主要挑战在于如何使地热能的开采和利用在经济上可行。

body.en:
It's hard to get Democrat and Republican politicians to agree on much at the moment, but the benefits of geothermal energy is one rare area of consensus.

Geothermal energy makes use of natural heat below the Earth's surface and the next generation of technology can access hotter, deeper and more varied locations than ever before.

Broadly, the low greenhouse gas emissions of geothermal plants appeals to liberals, while conservatives like the additional energy independence of geothermal, plus the use of drilling technology familiar in the oil and gas industry.

Some US states are trying to accelerate permits for geothermal plants and in April senators from both parties introduced the Next-Generation Geothermal , external Research and Development Act.

The legislation would direct the Department of Energy to support the development and commercialisation of the next generation of geothermal energy systems.

In EGS, underground rock is fractured hydraulically. That's done by pumping pressurised fluid into one well, and then collecting steam or hot water from another well.

Better known as fracking, this technique has become well known and controversial ( particularly in the UK ) in the oil and gas industry.

"It's the same techniques and up to a point it's the same industry as well," sums up Gernot Wagner, a climate economist at Columbia Business School in New York. But "from a climate perspective, there's a huge difference," he adds.

For him, the risk of seismic activity, by creating cracks underground, is outweighed by the benefits of an energy source that is renewable, always-on and large-capacity.

"Based on where we are, moving much faster, much bigger in the direction of using much more geothermal, frankly, is all good news," Wagner says.

Companies are developing drilling equipment that is more stable when breaking through hard rock at high temperatures.

Quaise, a company with roots at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), is using a technology called millimetre wave drilling. The frequency is similar to that of microwaves.

Quaise's application involves "sending electromagnetic waves in the microwave millimetre wave spectrum to essentially melt and vaporise through the rock," explains Harry Kelso, Quaise's communications manager.

Traditional geothermal energy clusters around hotspots on the earth's surface where very hot rocks can be easily accessed.

"Millimetre wave drilling really enables you to access super-hot geothermal just about anywhere in the world," says Kelso.

While Quaise is planning to use some conventional drilling at the project site it's developing in Oregon, Kelso says that conventional drills start to break down more quickly when it reaches very hard rock.

reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了人类从地球深处寻求可持续能源的智慧，这是一项充满经济挑战的重大事业。当初创公司致力于开发地热能时，箴言16:3提醒我们要将我们的计划交托给雅伟。这表明当我们为更高的目标奉献工作时，我们的努力，即使面临复杂的挑战，也能找到稳定和方向。

title.en: Red heat warning for south-east England; 150 million Europeans to experience temperatures above 35C today – Europe heatwave live
title.zh: 英格兰东南部发布红色高温预警；今日1.5亿欧洲人将经历35摄氏度以上高温——欧洲热浪实时报道

summary.en: South-east England is under a red heat warning for a third consecutive day, with 150 million Europeans expected to experience temperatures above 35C. Scientists state this is Europe's worst-ever heatwave and impossible without the climate crisis, leading to public alcohol bans in Paris and strain on hospitals.
summary.zh: 英国东南部连续第三天发布红色高温预警，预计今天将有1.5亿欧洲人经历35摄氏度以上的高温。科学家表示，这是欧洲有史以来最严重的热浪，若无气候危机则不可能发生，导致巴黎禁止公共饮酒，医院也面临压力。

body.en: Paris to ban drinking alcohol in public as city’s Pride march postponed; First time red warnings issued in UK for three consecutive days European heatwave is worst ever and impossible without climate crisis, scientists say Paris to ban drinking alcohol in public as hospitals hit heatwave breaking point Over in the UK, firefighters are still trying to bring a large wildfire in Derbyshire under control. The blaze, which has burned over 500 square metres of moorland and woodland on Tintwistle Moor, near Glossop, broke out on Wednesday evening, with fire crews from Manchester and Derbyshire deploying a water-dropping helicopter and six fire engines on Thursday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由于巴黎骄傲游行推迟，巴黎将禁止在公共场所饮酒；英国首次连续三天发布红色预警 欧洲热浪是有史以来最严重的，如果没有气候危机，科学家称巴黎将禁止在公共场所饮酒，因为医院达到热浪临界点 在英国，消防队员仍在努力控制德比郡的大火。大火于周三晚间爆发，已烧毁格洛索普附近廷特维斯尔沼泽 (Tinttwistle Moor) 500 多平方米的沼泽地和林地，来自曼彻斯特和德比郡的消防人员于周四部署了一架洒水直升机和六辆消防车。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The intense heatwave across Europe, with its severe impact on daily life and public health, reminds us of the profound interconnectedness between humanity and the natural world. As creation groans under the weight of environmental shifts, we are called to reflect on our role in stewarding the Earth and caring for one another amidst these challenges....
reflection.zh: 欧洲各地的高温热浪，对日常生活和公共健康造成了严重影响，这提醒我们人类与自然世界之间深刻的相互关联。当受造之物在环境变化的重压下发出叹息时，我们被呼召反思自己在管理地球和在这些挑战中彼此关怀的角色。雅伟的创造虽然有韧性，但也经历着痛苦，促使我们在应对时寻求智慧和怜悯。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Outrage as woman jailed for three years after criticising Somali government online
title.zh: 女子因网上批评索马里政府被判三年监禁引众怒

summary.en: A 27-year-old rickshaw driver in Somalia has been sentenced to three years in prison for comments she made on social media. The sentencing of Sadia Moalim Ali has drawn widespread condemnation from former political leaders and human rights organizations.
summary.zh: 一名27岁的索马里人力车司机因在社交媒体上发表评论而被判处三年监禁。萨迪亚·莫阿利姆·阿里被判刑一事受到了前政治领导人和人权组织的广泛谴责。

body.en: Sentencing of 27-year-old Sadia Moalim Ali condemned by former president and prime ministers as well as rights groups A rickshaw driver in Somalia has been sentenced to three years in prison for comments she made on social media, in a case that has caught the public’s attention and provoked outrage in the country. Sadia Moalim Ali, a 27-year-old nursing graduate, was originally charged with insulting government institutions and incitement to commit a crime, but convicted only of the former. Her sentence, immediately condemned as “fundamentally unjust”, was handed down on 25 June. Continue reading...
body.zh: 27岁萨迪亚·莫阿利姆·阿里的量刑受到前总统和总理以及人权组织的谴责索马里一名人力车司机因在社交媒体上发表的言论而被判处三年监禁，该案引起了公众的关注并在该国激起了公愤。 27 岁的护理专业毕业生萨迪亚·莫阿利姆·阿里 (Sadia Moalim Ali) 最初被指控侮辱政府机构和煽动犯罪，但仅被定罪为前者。 6 月 25 日，她的判决立即被谴责为“根本不公正”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The jailing of a citizen for expressing online criticism highlights the vulnerability of people under oppressive rule. Yahweh's word reminds us that a wicked ruler can be like a dangerous predator to a helpless populace. We pray for justice and freedom for all who are silenced for speaking truth.
reflection.zh: 一位公民因在网上发表批评言论而被监禁，这凸显了人民在压迫性统治下的脆弱。雅伟的话语提醒我们，邪恶的统治者对无助的人民来说，就像危险的捕食者。我们为所有因说出真相而被噤声的人祈求公义和自由。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Venezuela earthquakes: international rescue teams arrive, as 235 confirmed dead so far – latest updates
title.zh: 委内瑞拉地震：国际救援队抵达，已确认235人死亡——最新进展

summary.en: International rescue teams have arrived in Venezuela following a series of earthquakes, with 235 deaths confirmed so far. Authorities fear the final death toll could reach into the thousands, as rescue efforts continue.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉发生一系列地震后，国际救援队已抵达该国，目前已确认235人死亡。当局担心最终死亡人数可能达到数千人，救援工作仍在进行中。

body.en:
A group of 80 rescuers from Switzerland landed in Venezuela this morning, according to the country’s state broadcaster, VTV.

The Swiss delegation includes search and rescue specialists along with 18 tonnes of supplies and eight search dogs.

Turkey announced two flights will leave Istanbul today with military, medical and rescue personnel and a pair of search dogs, while the Netherlands also said it was sending a team consisting of 65 rescue workers, dogs and equipment.
body.zh: 据委内瑞拉国家电视台 VTV 报道，今天上午，一支由 80 名瑞士救援人员组成的救援队抵达委内瑞拉。 瑞士代表团包括搜救专家以及 18 吨物资和八只搜救犬。 土耳其宣布，两架飞机将于今天离开伊斯坦布尔，载有军事、医疗和救援人员以及一对搜救犬，而荷兰也表示将派遣一支由 65 名救援人员、搜救犬和设备组成的团队。

reflection.en: In the wake of such devastating loss, our hearts ache for those who have died and those who mourn. This verse reminds us of Yahweh's ultimate promise to wipe away every tear, bringing an end to death, sorrow, and pain. It offers a profound hope that beyond this present suffering, a time will come when such tragedies are no more.
reflection.zh: 面对如此毁灭性的损失，我们的心为逝者和哀悼者感到悲痛。这节经文提醒我们雅伟最终的应许，祂将擦去一切眼泪，使死亡、悲伤和痛苦不再存在。它提供了一个深刻的盼望，即超越眼前的苦难，一个不再有此类悲剧的时代终将到来。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Housing board votes to freeze New York rents in victory for Mamdani
title.zh: 住房委员会投票冻结纽约租金，马姆达尼获胜

summary.en: A New York housing board voted to freeze rents, a decision welcomed by many tenants but which landlords fear will lead to a deterioration of housing conditions.
summary.zh: 纽约住房委员会投票决定冻结租金，此举受到许多租户的欢迎，但房东们担心这会使住房状况恶化。

body.en:
A New York City housing board has approved a key pledge made by Mayor Zohran Mamdani to freeze rents for about one million regulated apartments.

The result of the vote on Thursday was greeted with cheers and whistles from hundreds of people in Manhattan as the Rent Guidelines Board (RGB) approved a freeze on both one and two year leases.

Mamdani said in a statement that it was a "historic victory for New York City tenants".

The board voted in favour of the policy 7-1, hours after the public resignation of one of its members Christina Smyth, who accused the panel of bias and of "knowingly disregarding its own evidence" that landlords face spiking operating costs.

Smyth was one of three members appointed by former New York City Mayor Eric Adams. Mamdani appointed the other six members after taking office this year.

Smyth, one of two landlord representatives on the board, said the outcome had been predetermined by the mayor.

"The rebuilt board was required to deliver a rent freeze," she said. "Everything since has been theater," she said in a statement.

Chair of the board, Chantella Mitchell, said the board's members served with independence and integrity.

In a statement concerning the rent freeze, she said "comprehensive data before the board this year reflect an economic environment in which most tenants in rent-stabilised housing struggle to meet basic affordability thresholds as housing costs continue to rise".

Rent-stabilised buildings will be eligible for the rent freeze across all five of the city's boroughs between October 2026 and September 2027. They include buildings ranging from high-rise luxury apartments to affordable subsidised units.

Tenants had argued in public hearings held ahead of the vote that incomes were not keeping up with inflation and that past rent increases hadn't gone towards building repairs or improvements.

But groups representing landlords warned that it would be more difficult to keep up with rising taxes, utilities and repairs as a result of the freeze, leading to worse conditions for renters.

"Older rent-stabilized buildings are already struggling under rising operating costs, yet the Board chose to disregard those realities," said James Whelan, president of the Real Estate Board of New York.

"This decision will mean less investment in maintenance and repairs, accelerating the deterioration of the housing stock that millions of New Yorkers call home," he said.

During Mamdani's campaign for mayor late last year, his election pledges centred on cost-of-living issues, with the rent freeze being one of the core promises.

Changing the make-up of the board was also among the democratic socialist mayor's pledges.

reflection.en: The housing board's decision to freeze rents highlights the complex challenge of governance: seeking justice for one group while considering the potential impact on others. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds those in authority of their mandate from Yahweh to "do justice and righteousness" and to "do no wrong or violence." This calls for careful discernment to ensure...
reflection.zh: 住房委员会冻结租金的决定，凸显了治理的复杂挑战：在为一群人寻求公义的同时，也要考虑对其他人的潜在影响。耶利米书22:3提醒掌权者，雅伟赋予他们的使命是“施行公平和公义”，并且“不可欺压、不可强暴”。这要求他们仔细辨别，确保政策真正服务于共同利益，而不会无意中制造新的困难。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Minister says he ‘won’t be intimidated’ by home secretary as public row escalates
title.zh: 大臣称不会被内政大臣“恐吓”，公开争执升级

summary.en: A public dispute has intensified between the UK Home Secretary, Shabana Mahmood, and a junior minister, Mike Tapp. Mahmood has called for Tapp's dismissal following his advocacy for an exemption for care workers from migration rules, to which Tapp responded that he would not be intimidated.
summary.zh: 英国国内政大臣沙巴娜·马哈茂德与一名初级部长迈克·塔普之间的公开争执升级。马哈茂德要求解雇塔普，原因是塔普呼吁对护理人员的移民规定予以豁免，而塔普则回应称他不会被恐吓。

body.en: Shabana Mahmood has demanded Mike Tapp be sacked over call for care worker exemption to migration rules UK politics live – latest updates An extraordinary public row between the home secretary, Shabana Mahmood, and one of her junior ministers has escalated after he said he “won’t be intimidated” in response to calls by her for him to be sacked. Mahmood demanded on Thursday that the migration minister, Mike Tapp, should be fired for writing an unauthorised article in the Times calling for overseas care workers to be exempt from controversial changes to the immigration rules. But Keir Starmer has so far not sacked Tapp for apparently breaking the rules around ministerial conduct. Continue reading...
body.zh: 沙巴纳·马哈茂德 (Shabana Mahmood) 要求解雇迈克·塔普 (Mike Tapp)，因为他呼吁护理人员免受移民规则的影响 英国政治直播 – 最新动态 内政大臣沙巴纳·马哈茂德 (Shabana Mahmood) 在回应塔普要求解雇他的呼吁时表示“不会被吓倒”后，与她的一位副部长之间的非同寻常的公开争吵升级。马哈茂德周四要求解雇移民部长迈克·塔普(Mike Tapp)，因为他在《泰晤士报》上发表了一篇未经授权的文章，呼吁海外护理人员免受有争议的移民规则修改的影响。但凯尔·斯塔默到目前为止还没有因为明显违反部长行为规则而解雇塔普。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Public disagreements among leaders can quickly escalate when personal ambition or pride takes precedence. Yahweh's word encourages us to act with humility, valuing others above ourselves, which can transform tense situations into opportunities for respectful dialogue and collaboration.
reflection.zh: 当个人野心或骄傲凌驾于一切之上时，领导者之间的公开分歧会迅速升级。雅伟的话语鼓励我们以谦卑行事，看别人比自己更重要，这能将紧张局势转化为尊重对话和合作的机会。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: First hydropower projects in Great Britain in 40 years given go-ahead
title.zh: 英国四十年来的首批水电项目获批

summary.en: Energy regulators in Great Britain have provisionally approved the construction of three new pumped storage hydroelectric power stations in Scotland. These projects are the first new hydropower developments in over 40 years and are part of broader plans for long-duration electricity storage.
summary.zh: 英国能源监管机构已初步批准在苏格兰建设三座新的抽水蓄能水电站。这些项目是四十多年来英国首次获批的新水电项目，也是长期电力储存计划的一部分。

body.en: Three pumped storage hydroelectric power station sites in Scotland on list of 16 long-duration electricity storage plans The energy regulator has given the provisional green light for the construction of the first new hydropower projects in more than 40 years, part of plans to reduce Great Britain’s reliance on energy imports. Ofgem has published a list of 16 long-duration electricity storage projects, facilities that can store and release electricity for periods of eight hours or more, it has provisionally agreed can proceed. Continue reading...
body.zh: 苏格兰的三个抽水蓄能水电站被列入 16 个长期电力存储计划清单 能源监管机构已为 40 多年来首个新水电项目的建设临时开绿灯，这是减少英国对能源进口依赖的计划的一部分。 Ofgem公布了16个长期储电项目清单，这些项目可以储存和释放电力8小时或更长时间，并暂时同意可以继续进行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The approval of new hydropower projects highlights humanity's ongoing role in harnessing creation's resources for our needs. This endeavor reminds us of the original mandate given by Yahweh God to work and care for the earth, seeking sustainable ways to thrive. May these projects be developed with wisdom and a deep sense of responsibility for the natural...
reflection.zh: 新水电项目的获批，彰显了人类在利用受造物资源以满足自身需求方面的持续角色。这提醒我们雅伟上帝最初赋予人类管理和看护大地的使命，寻求可持续发展之道。愿这些项目在智慧和对自然世界的深切责任感中得以发展。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Asia stock markets slide as tech shares slump
title.zh: 亚洲股市因科技股暴跌而下滑

summary.en: Asian stock markets experienced significant declines, with tech shares particularly affected. Trading on South Korea's Kospi index was temporarily halted multiple times this week to curb widespread panic selling.
summary.zh: 亚洲股市大幅下跌，科技股尤其受到影响。本周，韩国综合股价指数（Kospi）多次暂停交易，以防止大规模恐慌性抛售。

body.en:
Asian stock markets fell sharply on Friday, led by a sell-off in technology firms as investors worried that recent jumps in share prices had gone too far.

Trading on South Korea's Kospi was temporarily halted as an 8% fall in the benchmark index triggered a mechanism intended to curb panic selling. The index closed 5.8% lower.

It comes after shares in Apple fell sharply on Thursday after it announced it would raise the prices of its iPads and MacBooks due to the soaring cost of computer chips.

Some investors are also concerned about the hundreds of billions of dollars being spent this year by big tech firms to build artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure.

Traders are reassessing the valuations of tech stocks, while some are taking profits after a rally in recent months, said senior partner David Makaryan from the Alpha Pacific Group, an investment firm.

"The long term investment case for AI remains compelling, but investors are becoming far more selective about which companies can justify the valuations the market has assigned to them," Makaryan said.

Elsewhere in Asia, Japan's Nikkei 225 closed more than 4% lower as shares in technology investment giant SoftBank fell by 12.5%.

Other major indexes in the region, including in Taiwan and mainland China, were also sharply lower.

Friday's 20-minute halt on the Kospi marked the third time the so-called circuit breaker has been triggered this week and the fifth such event this year.

On Thursday in the US, Apple shares dropped by 6% - its biggest one-day fall in more than a year.

Microsoft shares also fell after it announced higher prices for its Xbox gaming consoles, citing higher costs of components.

The moves have raised concerns that rising component prices could hit sales of devices, which in turn may slow demand for computer chips.

The high cost of commercialising AI tools is gradually being passed on to consumers, said analyst Raymond Woo from Kyoto University Innovation Capital.

That "naturally raises questions" about how quickly demand for such tools will match the investment into AI, and whether the valuations of tech stocks today are realistic, Woo said.
body.zh: 周五，亚洲股市大幅下跌，科技公司遭到抛售，投资者担心近期股价上涨幅度过大。 由于基准指数下跌 8%，触发了旨在遏制恐慌性抛售的机制，韩国综合股价指数 (Kospi) 交易暂时停止。该指数收盘下跌 5.8%。 周四，苹果公司宣布因计算机芯片成本飙升而提高 iPad 和 MacBook 的价格，导致其股价大幅下跌。 一些投资者还对大型科技公司今年花费数千亿美元建设人工智能（AI）基础设施感到担忧。 投资公司 Alpha Pacific Group 的高级合伙人 David Makaryan 表示，交易员正在重新评估科技股的估值，而一些科技股在近几个月的上涨后正在获利了结。 马卡里安表示：“人工智能的长期投资理由仍然引人注目，但投资者对哪些公司能够证明市场赋予它们的估值合理，变得更加挑剔。” 在亚洲其他地区，日本日经 225 指数收盘下跌逾 4%，科技投资巨头软银股价下跌 12.5%。 该地区的其他主要指数，包括台湾和中国大陆，也大幅下跌。 周五 Kospi 指数暂停 20 分钟，标志着本周第三次触发所谓的熔断机制，也是今年第五次触发此类事件。 周四，苹果股价在美国下跌 6%，创下一年多来最大单日跌幅。 微软股价也下跌，此前该公司宣布其 Xbox 游戏机价格上涨，理由是组件成本上涨。 这些举措引发了人们的担忧，即零部件价格上涨可能会影响设备的销售，进而可能减缓对计算机芯片的需求。 京都大学创新资本分析师 Raymond Woo 表示，人工智能工具商业化的高昂成本正在逐渐转嫁给消费者。 吴说，这“自然会引发一些问题”，即对此类工具的需求将多快与人工智能的投资相匹配，以及目前科技股的估值是否现实。

reflection.en: The rapid slide in stock markets and the resulting panic selling remind us of the fragile nature of earthly wealth. Yahweh's word encourages us not to place our ultimate security in treasures that can be lost, but to seek lasting value beyond what markets can offer.
reflection.zh: 股市的迅速下滑和随之而来的恐慌性抛售，提醒我们世上财富的脆弱本质。雅伟的话语鼓励我们不要将最终的安全感寄托在可能失去的财宝上，而是寻求超越市场所能提供的永恒价值。

verse.textEn: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moths and vermin destroy.
verse.textZh: 不要为自己积攒财宝在地上；地上有虫子咬，能锈坏。

title.en: UN pauses Strait of Hormuz evacuation plan after cargo ship attacked
title.zh: 联合国在货船遇袭后暂停霍尔木兹海峡撤离计划

summary.en: An evacuation plan by the United Nations in the Strait of Hormuz has been halted following an attack on a cargo ship near Oman. Reports indicate the vessel was hit by an "unknown projectile," though no casualties were reported.
summary.zh: 联合国暂停了霍尔木兹海峡的撤离计划，此前一艘货船在阿曼附近遭到袭击。据报道，该船被一枚“不明弹丸”击中，但没有人员伤亡报告。

body.en:
The UN's International Maritime Organization (IMO) has paused the planned evacuation of more than 11,000 sailors stranded in the Strait of Hormuz after a cargo ship passing through the waterway was attacked.

IMO chief Arsenio Dominguez said several boats had already been evacuated, but the agency wanted to ensure that "necessary safety guarantees" would continue to be in place.

The British maritime security agency UKMTO reported on Thursday that a ship had been struck 7.5 nautical miles southeast of Oman's port of Dahit by "an unknown projectile". No casualties were reported.

The attack came after Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) had warned that attempts to cross the strait along a route designated by the IMO would be "unacceptable and completely dangerous" and vessels should coordinate with Iran.

Maritime risk management firm Vanguard said the ship, the Singapore-flagged Ever Lovely, continued through the strait despite the attack.

The Ever Lovely followed a southern route identified by the IMO on Thursday morning, data from the ship-tracking website MarineTraffic reviewed by BBC Verify shows.

It was leading a flotilla of four other ships, the Wall Street Journal reported.

There was no warning from the Iranian navy to the ships on radio, according to seafarers in the flotilla who spoke to the paper.

IMO chief Dominguez said in a statement on Thursday that the vessel that was attacked "did not transit under IMO's evacuation framework".

"I have always reiterated that the safety of the seafarers remains paramount. Therefore, to ensure a coordinated approach and navigational safety, the evacuation plan will be paused until further clarity is obtained," he said.

Hundreds of ships and thousands of sailors have been stranded in the Gulf since February because of the US-Israel war against Iran.

The UN evacuation effort was announced on Tuesday following the reopening of the strait, with Dominguez saying the "large-scale operation" had the cooperation of Iran, Oman, the US, other coastal states in the region and the maritime industry.

The attack came after the body set up by Iran to manage the strait said vessels passing outside designated routes would not be guaranteed safe passage.

In a post on X, the Persian Gulf Strait Authority (PGSA) said: "Any consequences arising from the use of unauthorised routes shall be the responsibility of the vessel's owner, operator and master".

Many ships had been using an alternative route on the southern side of the strait, hugging the coast of Oman, the New York Times reports.

Last week the US and Iran agreed to end hostilities under a 14-point deal - which also called for Iran to use its "best efforts for the safe passage of commercial vessels with no charge for 60 days".

body.zh: 一艘穿过霍尔木兹海峡的货船遭到袭击后，联合国国际海事组织（IMO）暂停了对滞留在霍尔木兹海峡的 11,000 多名水手的疏散计划。 国际海事组织主席阿塞尼奥·多明计斯表示，几艘船只已经被疏散，但该机构希望确保“必要的安全保证”继续到位。 英国海事安全机构 UKMTO 周四报告称，一艘船在阿曼达希特港东南 7.5 海里处被“不明弹丸”击中。没有人员伤亡报告。 此次袭击发生之前，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）警告称，试图沿着国际海事组织指定的路线穿越海峡将是“不可接受的，而且是完全危险的”，船只应与伊朗协调。 海事风险管理公司Vanguard表示，尽管遭到袭击，这艘悬挂新加坡国旗的Ever Lovely号船仍继续通过海峡。 BBC verify 查阅的船舶跟踪网站 MarineTraffic 的数据显示，周四上午，Ever Lovely 号沿着 IMO 确定的南部路线行驶。 据《华尔街日报》报道，它率领着另外四艘船组成的舰队。 据接受该报采访的船队海员称，伊朗海军没有通过无线电向船只发出警告。 国际海事组织主席多明计斯周四在一份声明中表示，遭到袭击的船只“并未在国际海事组织的疏散框架下过境”。 他说：“我一直重申，海员的安全仍然是最重要的。因此，为了确保协调一致和航行安全，疏散计划将暂停，直到进一步明确情况为止。” 自二月份以来，由于美以对伊朗的战争，数百艘船只和数千名水手被困在海湾地区。 联合国周二在海峡重新开放后宣布了撤离行动，多明计斯表示，这次“大规模行动”得到了伊朗、阿曼、美国、该地区其他沿海国家和海运业的合作。 此次袭击发生之前，伊朗设立的海峡管理机构表示，在指定航线之外通过的船只将无法保证安全通行。 波斯湾海峡管理局（PGSA）在X的帖子中表示：“因使用未经授权的航线而产生的任何后果应由船舶所有人、经营者和船长负责”。 据《纽约时报》报道，许多船只一直在使用海峡南侧的替代路线，沿着阿曼海岸。 上周，美国和伊朗同意根据一项 14 点协议结束敌对行动，该协议还呼吁伊朗“尽最大努力确保商船在 60 天内免费安全通行”。 然而，德黑兰...

reflection.en: The attack on a cargo ship, leading to a paused evacuation, reminds us how fragile peace can be in volatile regions. Yahweh calls us to pursue peace whenever possible, even when faced with unexpected aggression that disrupts stability. This incident underscores the ongoing human responsibility to seek peaceful coexistence amidst global tensions.
reflection.zh: 货船遇袭导致撤离计划暂停，这提醒我们和平在动荡地区是多么脆弱。雅伟呼召我们，只要可能，就与众人和睦相处，即使面对意外的侵略，稳定受到干扰。这一事件强调了在国际紧张局势中，人类持续寻求和平共处的责任。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Reflecting Pool liner cut with sharp knife or razor, National Park Service says
title.zh: 国家公园管理局称反思池内衬被利器割破

summary.en: The National Park Service reported that the liner of the Reflecting Pool was cut with a sharp object. This follows earlier accusations by Donald Trump, who blamed vandals for a "300 foot long gash" and alleged that fertilizer had been put in the water.
summary.zh: 国家公园管理局报告称，反思池的内衬被利器割破。此前，唐纳德·特朗普曾指责破坏者造成了池中“300英尺长的裂口”，并声称有人在水中投放了肥料。

body.en:
A liner along the bottom of the Reflecting Pool in Washington DC was cut with a sharp knife or razor earlier this month, an official at the National Park Service has said.

Frank Lands, deputy director of operations for the park service, said in a court filing on Thursday that US Park Police had responded to a report of an incident on 9 June regarding the pool's liner, which caused damage to the foam sealant that had been installed as part of a recent multi-million dollar rehabilitation project.

Earlier this week, US President Donald Trump blamed vandals for "a 300-foot-long gash" and accused someone of putting fertiliser in the water.

The president was pressed by CBS News during an interview , external for evidence of the slit, which Trump said would be provided in court.

In the recent court filing, Lands said a US Park Police report indicated damage "including a caulk over the foam sealant that was cut with a sharp knife or razor and destruction of delaminating surface material."

It also detailed that "approximately 70 fence post tops were thrown into the pool".

However, it does not say when exactly the damage occurred and does not identify anyone who might have been involved.

The statement in the court filing is part of a lawsuit filed by a nonprofit organisation seeking to stop the Trump administration's work on the site.

It is also the first public record detailing how the pool may have been damaged after work on the project was completed.

Renovations to the The Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool started in April and went on for two months, under Trump's request, ahead of the 250th anniversary of the United States.

"The 2,000-foot-long basin was drained" and "a tinted polyurea liner" was installed in the pool to "waterproof and protect the concrete pool surface", the NPS outlined in its statement.

But after being refilled with water, the pool was plagued by an algae bloom and developed issues with the deep blue paint that was added to its bottom.

Five people have been arrested for vandalism in connection with the Reflecting Pool, and five others were issued federal citations, according to US Park Police.

The NPS plans to drain the pool once more after Independence Day celebrations on 4 July to "conduct repairs, including assessments and repairing any damage to the lining", Lands said.

The pool, which was built in the 1920s and stretches 2,030ft (619m) between the Lincoln Memorial and the Washington Monument, has long suffered from leaks, structural deterioration, faulty pipes, algae growth and bird droppings.
body.zh: 美国国家公园管理局的一名官员表示，本月早些时候，华盛顿特区倒影池底部的一条衬垫被锋利的刀或剃刀割伤。 公园管理局运营副主任弗兰克·兰德斯 (Frank Lands) 在周四提交的一份法庭文件中表示，美国公园警察局已对 6 月 9 日发生的一起泳池内衬事件报告做出了回应，该事件对最近耗资数百万美元的修复项目中安装的泡沫密封剂造成了损坏。 本周早些时候，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普指责破坏者造成了“300英尺长的伤口”，并指责有人将化肥放入水中。 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻在接受外部采访时向总统施压，要求提供裂缝的证据，特朗普表示将在法庭上提供这些证据。 在最近的法庭文件中，兰兹表示，美国公园警察的一份报告显示，损坏情况“包括用锋利的刀或剃刀切割的泡沫密封剂上的填缝以及分层表面材料的破坏”。 它还详细说明“大约 70 个栅栏柱顶部被扔进水池中”。 然而，它没有说明损害发生的具体时间，也没有指出可能涉及的任何人。 法庭文件中的声明是一家非营利组织提起诉讼的一部分，该诉讼旨在阻止特朗普政府在该网站上的工作。 这也是第一个公开记录，详细说明了项目完成后水池可能受到的损坏。 在美国建国 250 周年纪念日之前，应特朗普的要求，林肯纪念堂倒影池的翻修工程于 4 月开始，持续了两个月。 NPS 在声明中概述道，“2000 英尺长的水池已排水”，并在水池中安装了“有色聚脲衬垫”，以“防水并保护混凝土水池表面”。 但在重新注满水后，游泳池受到藻类大量繁殖的困扰，并且底部添加的深蓝色油漆也出现了问题。 据美国公园警察称，五人因与倒影池有关的破坏行为被捕，另外五人受到联邦传票。 Lands 表示，NPS 计划在 7 月 4 日独立日庆祝活动后再次排空泳池，以“进行修复，包括评估和修复对内衬的任何损坏”。 该泳池建于 1920 年代，在林肯纪念堂和华盛顿纪念碑之间绵延 2,030 英尺（619 m），长期以来一直遭受泄漏、结构恶化、管道故障、藻类生长和鸟粪等问题的困扰。

reflection.en: The deliberate damage to a public landmark like the Reflecting Pool reminds us that all creation, including shared spaces, ultimately belongs to Yahweh. Such acts of vandalism disrespect not only human effort and public resources but also the divine ownership of all things. We are called to be good stewards of the world and its common spaces, treating them...
reflection.zh: 对反思池等公共地标的蓄意破坏提醒我们，所有受造物，包括共享空间，最终都属于雅伟。这种破坏行为不仅不尊重人类的努力和公共资源，也无视雅伟对万物的神圣主权。我们蒙召作世界及其公共空间的良好管家，以爱护和尊重的态度对待它们。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: King Charles is the first UK monarch to release their tax bill. Here's what it shows
title.zh: 查尔斯国王成为首位公布税单的英国君主。以下是其内容

summary.en: It was also revealed that the king and Queen Camilla will not live in Buckingham Palace after a £369 million refurbishment.
summary.zh: 另据透露，在耗资3.69亿英镑翻修后，国王和卡米拉王后将不会入住白金汉宫。

body.en:
King Charles has revealed that he paid £12.9 million (more than $24.6 million) in tax last year, marking the first time a monarch has publicly disclosed how much personal tax he paid.

That places Charles among the UK's top 100 taxpayers between 2024-2025, local media reported.

The monarch is not liable for tax, but his mother, Queen Elizabeth, began paying it voluntarily in 1993.

Buckingham Palace described the landmark disclosure as part of its "commitment to transparency". Royal finances have long been considered complex, murky and difficult to decipher, and the latest disclosure — which did not include breakdowns of how the figures were calculated — does little to lift the veil.

Royal finances have come under increasing scrutiny in recent years, including following a recent watchdog report into property arrangements involving the king's brother, Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor.

body.en:
Australians have been caught up in the devastating earthquakes that hit Venezuela on Thursday.

The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has confirmed that it is providing consular support "to a small number of Australians that have been affected by the earthquake in Venezuela".

"Owing to our privacy obligations we are unable to provide further comment on individual cases," a spokesperson told SBS News in a statement. They did not confirm in what capacity those citizens have been impacted.

Australian officials are in close contact with local authorities, government, and partners who are attempting to rescue those trapped under the rubble.

Australia does not have an embassy in Venezuela, and the government's ability to provide consular assistance is severely limited.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Friday that his heart "goes out" to anyone with relatives or friends in the country who have been affected by the natural disasters that struck the country's north on Thursday .

"This is one of the worst earthquakes that we've seen in recent times, with catastrophic human consequences, a massive loss of life, but also massive infrastructure damage and real consequences for the people of Venezuela," the prime minister told ABC News Breakfast.

Genesis Lindstrom, president of the Venezuelan Association of Australia, has her community has been desperately seeking information, which is challenging to access given the number of media outlets suspended in the country.

"A lot of the news and updates we're getting are from social media and from people sending through videos and updates," she told News Breakfast.

Lindstrom added that she was in the office when the news broke and started frantically messaging everyone she knows in the country's capital, Caracas.

"Thankfully, as far as I know, most people in my community here have been getting those messages across from family members and loved ones," she said.

Desperate Venezuelans are continuing to dig for people trapped beneath the debris in the worst-hit state of La Guaira, north of Caracas.

The United States Geological Survey measured the earthquakes as magnitudes 7.2 and 7.5, which struck within minutes of each other on Thursday.

Venezuela's health minister Carlos Alvarado said the death toll had risen to 235. At least 1,520 are thought to be injured.

The United Nation's Central Emergency Response Fund has released $22 million to support response efforts in Venezuela.

United Nations-certified rescuers will help search for survivors, interim Venezuelan president Delcy Rodriguez said in a televised message.

title.en: King Charles won't live in Buckingham Palace, reveals taxes
title.zh: 查尔斯国王将不住白金汉宫，税收揭示原因

summary.en: King Charles III and Queen Camilla will not make Buckingham Palace their primary residence, breaking a nearly two-century tradition for British monarchs. Royal officials confirmed the decision, with the palace remaining the administrative headquarters of the monarchy.
summary.zh: 英国国王查尔斯三世和卡米拉王后将不会把白金汉宫作为他们的主要居所，这打破了英国君主近两个世纪的传统。王室官员证实了这一决定，白金汉宫仍将是君主制的行政总部。

body.en:
Buckingham Palace has been the British monarch's official residence in London for nearly two centuries. But royal officials say King Charles and Queen Camilla won't reside there.

King Charles III will not live at Buckingham Palace after its 10-year refurbishment program finishes next year, royal officials said on Thursday.  

The king and Queen Camilla will instead continue to live at Clarence House, his longstanding London ​home nearby.

James Chalmers, the king's treasurer and keeper of the privy purse, said Buckingham Palace would remain the primary venue for ceremonial and official functions, including receiving foreign dignitaries.

"It is and will remain monarchy HQ, the crown jewel of our national buildings," Chalmers told reporters.

Buckingham Palace has been the British monarch's primary London residence for nearly two centuries, since Queen Victoria became sovereign in 1837.

The 775-room building has not only served as the official residence of the monarch but also provided office space for the royal bureaucracy and hosted lavish state dinners for visiting foreign leaders.

The work started in 2017 and is expected to conclude next year, with the total cost projected at 369 million pounds (€428.2 million, $486.7 million).

Some 700,000 people visit the building every year. There will be greater public access, the official said, without providing details.

On Thursday, Charles also released to the public the details of his personal taxes paid to the government, marking the first time he has done so since becoming the monarch in 2022. 

By law, the British king is not obliged to pay income, capital gains or inheritance tax.

But Charles, like his mother, Queen Elizabeth II , did after 1993, has voluntarily done so without disclosing the amounts.

The British monarch receives money from the government, known as the Sovereign Grant, to pay for staff, royal palaces and travel.

But Charles, like all monarchs since 1399, also receives millions of pounds in private income from ​the vast Duchy of Lancaster estate as well as his other investments.

Meanwhile, Prince William, heir to the throne, paid 7.76 million pounds in tax in 2024/25.

The announcements come as the  royal family's reputation took a beating after months of embarrassing headlines about the links between the former Prince Andrew, now known as Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor , and the convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
body.zh: 近两个世纪以来，白金汉宫一直是英国君主在伦敦的官邸。但王室官员表示，查尔斯国王和卡米拉王后不会住在那里。 王室官员周四表示，白金汉宫为期十年的整修计划将于明年完成，查理三世国王将不再居住在白金汉宫。 国王和卡米拉王后将继续住在附近他在伦敦长期居住的克拉伦斯宫。 国王财务主管兼私库管理员詹姆斯·查默斯表示，白金汉宫仍将是举行仪式和官方活动的主要场所，包括接待外国政要。 查默斯对记者说：“它现在是、将来仍然是君主制总部，是我们国家建筑皇冠上的明珠。” 自 1837 年维多利亚女王登基以来，白金汉宫近两个世纪以来一直是英国君主在伦敦的主要住所。 这座拥有 775 间客房的建筑不仅是君主的官邸，还为皇家官僚机构提供办公空间，并为来访的外国领导人举办奢华的国宴。 该工程于 2017 年开始，预计明年完成，总成本预计为 3.69 亿英镑（4.282 亿欧元，4.867 亿美元）。 每年约有 70 万人参观该建筑。这位官员表示，将会有更多的公众参与，但没有提供细节。 周四，查尔斯还向公众公布了他向政府缴纳的个人税的详细信息，这是他自 2022 年成为君主以来首次这样做。 根据法律，英国国王没有义务缴纳收入、资本利得或遗产税。 但查尔斯像他的母亲伊丽莎白二世女王一样，在 1993 年之后自愿这样做，但没有透露具体金额。 英国君主从政府获得资金，称为君主拨款，用于支付工作人员、王宫和旅行的费用。 但与 1399 年以来的所有君主一样，查尔斯也从庞大的兰开斯特公国庄园以及其他投资中获得数百万英镑的私人收入。 与此同时，王位继承人威廉王子在2024/25年度缴纳了776万英镑的税款。 这些消息发布之际，前安德鲁王子（现称安德鲁·蒙巴顿-温莎）与被定罪的性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦之间的联系连续几个月成为令人尴尬的头条新闻，导致王室声誉受到打击。

The Socceroos, who defeated Türkiye in their opening match before losing to the United States, were never seriously threatened on their way to securing a point to reach the last 32.

title.en: The 'yellow line' Gazans have been killed for crossing, according to new report
title.zh: 新报告称，加沙人因越过“黄线”而被杀害

summary.en: A new report indicates that children in Gaza continue to be targeted even after a ceasefire, a finding that Israel has rejected.

body.en:
Eight months after the Gaza ceasefire began , Palestinian children are still being targeted by Israeli forces for crossing the vaguely defined "yellow line", according to a new report from the United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry.

The commission alleges Israeli forces have continued to deliberately target Palestinian children during the ceasefire, which, alongside the targeting of healthcare and education facilities and restricting the flow of aid, it says is severely impacting the ability of children to thrive.

"Even if the bombs and guns fall silent in Gaza and the West Bank, Palestinian children will not simply recover overnight," the commission's chair, Srinivasan Muralidhar, said in a statement.

The United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry, which does not speak on behalf of the UN as a whole and has been sharply criticised by Israel, concluded in September that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza.

Israel is separately defending a genocide case at the International Court of Justice (ICJ), which has ordered provisional measures but has yet to issue a final ruling.

A spokesperson for Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs rejected the recent report's findings, calling it a "propaganda piece as outrageous as its previous ones".

"It completely erases Israeli children who were brutally murdered, kidnapped, and targeted by Hamas, while ignoring Hamas' cynical use of Palestinian children as human shields and pawns of war," it said.

Since the ceasefire began in October, the Ministry of Health in Gaza reported that at least 978 Palestinians had been killed, and just under 4,000 injured — a statistic that cannot be independently verified as Israel does not permit international journalists to enter Gaza.

The United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) estimated 265 of post-ceasefire deaths were children.

Israel and Hamas have repeatedly accused each other of violating the truce since it came into effect.

Australian emergency doctor Thienminh Dinh, 37, managed medical activities at the Doctors Without Borders field hospital in Al-Zawaida, Gaza, for two stints.

The first, between May and June 2025, was before the ceasefire. The second stint, between October and December 2025, began shortly after the ceasefire was announced.

She told SBS News there was a slight decrease in the volume of air strikes after the ceasefire, but the attacks still continued.

"There were still daily blasts. We also saw critical medical supplies, humanitarian and infant formula repeatedly delayed or obstructed from reaching our team."

title.en: Young people avoiding the news, Reuters report
title.zh: 路透社报告：年轻人正在回避新闻

summary.en: A Reuters Digital News Report, presented at DW's Global Media Forum, indicates that a significant number of young people are increasingly avoiding news consumption. Despite this trend, the report's author emphasized the continued importance of journalism.
summary.zh: 路透社数字新闻报告在德国之声全球媒体论坛上发布，报告显示，越来越多的年轻人正在回避新闻。尽管有此趋势，报告作者仍强调新闻业的重要性。

body.en:
An alarming number of young people are turning away from the news, according to the Reuters Digital News Report presented at DW's Global Media Forum. Despite this, the report's author says, "journalism still matters."

How do people stay informed in our digital age? And who do they trust? The Reuters Digital News Report 2026 answers those questions. The study, presented at the DW Global Media Forum in Bonn, shows how journalism and its usage is evolving — especially among young people.

Jim Egan, who led the study, didn't exactly strike an optimistic tone in his presentation, saying that the "data this year is quite unsettling in many aspects." Egan is the main author of the report — carried out by the Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism at the University of Oxford — the largest annual survey on news consumption of its kind globally.

Egan pointed out that the report's aim is not to provide comfort but rather to present a snapshot of reality: "We do this as an exercise in trying to insert some facts and some comparative analysis across different markets into an industry and into an ecosystem that is full of opinion but does not always know what's actually going on."

One of the most important findings in the report: Social media networks and video platforms are more frequently used as news sources than television or the websites and apps of news outlets themselves.

The phenomenon has less to do with booming platforms than with a turn away from classic news formats: "So social media consumption and usage itself isn't actually growing very much," said Egan. "But what we're seeing is a decline in the use of other platforms, such as television broadcast news, as well as going direct to a news organization's website or its app."

This transformation is especially prevalent among younger target audiences. In the US, more than one-third of all respondents under 25 said they had never watched TV newscasts or used news websites regularly. "They're not only leaving," said Egan, "they're not even starting."

At the same time, the report warns against seeking to expand reach at any cost. Young people are avid users of social media and video platforms but trust in news is also at its lowest there, according to Egan. "There's an irony here that people are moving more and more to platforms that they trust less."

Simultaneously, the report finds that video formats are becoming massively important. Some 75% of respondents claim to watch news videos weekly — especially on platforms such as YouTube, TikTok and Instagram . Globally, 20% use TikTok as a source for news and 34% turn to YouTube. This number varies significantly by country. In Kenya, for instance, 66% of consumers get their news via YouTube .

title.en: Latin America: Why are voters turning to the right?
title.zh: 拉丁美洲：选民为何转向右翼？

summary.en: Far-right populist leaders have recently won several presidential elections in Latin America, prompting questions about their growing popularity and potential longevity in the region's political landscape.
summary.zh: 近期，极右翼民粹主义领导人在拉丁美洲的多次总统选举中击败左翼候选人，引发了人们对其日益增长的人气和在该地区政治格局中持久性的疑问。

body.en:
Far-right populists seem to be on the rise in Latin America after defeating leftist candidates in a number of recent presidential elections. Why are they so popular? And are they here to stay?

Last weekend, rightwing-extremist candidate Abelardo de la Espriella edged out left-wing opponent Ivan Cepeda to win Colombia 's presidential election in a campaign in which the former focused heavily on the nation's security crisis.

In Chile , another extreme-right candidate, Jose Antonio Kast , took the reins from a leftist government in March elections. Kast, who is pursuing cuts to education and welfare while handing out tax cuts to businesses, openly talks about Chile's military dictatorship under General Augusto Pinochet (1973-1990) as something positive.

And right-wing populist Javier Milei , a great admirer of US President Donald Trump , has run Argentina since 2023. He, too, says he is betting on austerity to save his financially destitute nation.

Right-wing, conservative or economic liberalist forces now govern Bolivia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, El Salvador, Honduras, Panama, Paraguay and Peru as well.

Brazil, Cuba, Guatemala, Mexico, Nicaragua, Uruguay and Venezuela, on the other hand, are run by leftist-liberal or far-left governments.

Brazil , the largest and most populous country in Latin America, will head to the polls this fall in a race that pits incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva of the country's leftist Workers' Party (PT) against Flavio Bolsonaro, the far-right son of the country's jailed former president, Jair Bolsonaro .

Political control has reversed in eight Latin American countries since 2023 — left to right in six cases, right to left in the other two. But what's behind the shift?

Sabine Kurtenbach, head of the German Institute for Global and Area Studies in Hamburg, Germany, says recent right-wing victories can be boiled down to three closely related issues: Extreme social inequality, high crime rates and a lack of rule of law — and the fact that incumbents have consistently failed to get these under control. 

In Colombia, Abelardo de la Espriella promised voters he would take on armed guerrillas and drug cartels. Kurtenbach calls this "punitive populism," or the "Bukele model" — after El Salvador's controversial President Nayib Bukele, who declared a state of emergency in the country three years ago. Since then, more than 75,000 Salvadorans have been jailed, many without trial.

Jonas Wolff, a professor of political science specialized on Latin America at Goethe University in Frankfurt, Germany, points to security concerns and general voter dissatisfaction as reasons for the continent's current lunge to the right. That, he says, is a reversal of a decades-long trend.

title.en: Sudan: Warnings mount over the risk of new mass atrocities
title.zh: 苏丹：关于新一轮大规模暴行风险的警告不断增加

summary.en: Fears are escalating in Sudan as the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces gather around el-Obeid, raising concerns of potential mass atrocities similar to those previously witnessed in Darfur's el-Fasher. International warnings are mounting, with questions about whether sanctions could still prevent further bloodshed.
summary.zh: 随着苏丹准军事快速支援部队在战略城市奥贝德附近集结，人们越来越担心可能发生类似于达尔富尔法希尔地区曾出现的大规模暴行。国际社会发出了越来越多的警告，并质疑制裁是否仍能阻止流血事件。

body.en:
As Sudan's paramilitary Rapid Support Forces mass around the strategic city of el-Obeid, fears are growing of atrocities similar to those seen in Darfur's el-Fasher. Could sanctions still prevent bloodshed?

The next major front line in Sudan's war is most likely the strategically important city of el-Obeid in North Kordofan. This week, the UN Security Council, several European countries and the United States flagged  "the imminent risk of mass atrocities" as increasing numbers of paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) troops are  deployed around the city .

The assumption is largely that the RSF is preparing a ground offensive to try to retake the city, which has been under the control of the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) since February 2025.

The war in Sudan  has been ongoing since a rift between the two rival generals — Abdel-Fattah Burhan of the Sudanese Armed Forces and Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo of the Rapid Support Forces — escalated in April 2023. Since then, fighting has divided the country into army-held territories in the north and center, including Sudan's capital, Khartoum , and RSF-controlled areas in Sudan's western Darfur region and parts of the south.

Sudan, rich in oil and gold and with its vast agricultural lands, has also turned into the world's largest humanitarian and displacement crisis  over the course of the war. According to the UN , more than 14 million people have been displaced within Sudan and neighboring countries. The estimated death toll ranges between 40,000 and 250,000 people as reliable figures remain difficult to obtain due to ongoing fighting.

The city of el-Obeid, with a population of about 500,000 people is at the crossroads between central Sudan, Khartoum and the western Darfur region. It is therefore a key gateway for troop movements and military or humanitarian supplies. It is also home to a large SAF military base and a military airfield.

"El-Obeid has been an important logistical hub for supply lines throughout its entire history," Hager Ali, a researcher at the German think tank GIGA Institute for Global and Area Studies, told DW.

"If the RSF managed to retake el-Obeid, they would not only profit from its urban infrastructure and lucrative gum arabic trade but they could also use the city as a strategic forward operating base for launching drones ," she said.

Over the course of the war, drones have become a key weapon for both factions . According to the UN human rights agency, more than 1,000 civilians were killed in drone strikes between January and May 2026.

body.zh: 随着苏丹准军事快速支援部队在战略城市奥贝德周围集结，人们越来越担心发生类似于达尔富尔法希尔的暴行。制裁还能防止流血吗？ 苏丹战争的下一个主要前线很可能是北科尔多凡州具有重要战略意义的城市奥贝德。本周，随着越来越多的快速支援部队（RSF）部队在该市周围部署，联合国安理会、几个欧洲国家和美国指出“大规模暴行迫在眉睫”。 人们普遍认为，RSF 正在准备发动地面攻势，试图夺回这座自 2025 年 2 月以来一直处于苏丹武装部队 (SAF) 控制之下的城市。 自苏丹武装部队的阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·布尔汉和快速支援部队的穆罕默德·哈姆丹·达加洛这两位敌对将军之间的裂痕于 2023 年 4 月升级以来，苏丹的战争一直在持续。此后，战斗将国家分为北部和中部由军队控制的领土，包括苏丹首都喀土穆，以及苏丹西达尔富尔地区和南部部分地区由无国界医生组织控制的地区。 苏丹盛产石油和黄金，拥有广阔的农田，在战争过程中也陷入了世界上最大的人道主义和流离失所危机。据联合国称，苏丹及其邻国境内已有超过 1400 万人流离失所。由于持续的战斗，仍然难以获得可靠的数字，估计死亡人数在 40,000 至 250,000 人之间。 奥贝德市人口约50万，位于苏丹中部、喀土穆和西达尔富尔地区的交汇处。因此，它是部队调动和军事或人道主义物资的关键门户。它也是大型新加坡武装部队军事基地和军用机场的所在地。 德国智库GIGA全球与区域研究所研究员海格·阿里告诉德国之声：“在整个历史上，奥贝德一直是供应线的重要后勤枢纽。” 她说：“如果无国界医生组织成功夺回奥贝德，他们不仅可以从其城市基础设施和利润丰厚的阿拉伯树胶贸易中获利，还可以利用这座城市作为发射无人机的战略前沿作战基地。” 在战争过程中，无人机已成为双方的关键武器。据联合国人权机构称，2026 年 1 月至 5 月期间，已有 1000 多名平民在无人机袭击中丧生。 然而，随着七月雨季的开始，战斗无人机的轨迹变得更难以预测，阿里说。 “如果无国界医生组织想要向苏丹境内的其他城市推进，最明智的行动方针是……

reflection.en: The news from Sudan, with paramilitary forces threatening mass atrocities, echoes the ancient wisdom that a wicked ruler can be like a predatory beast over a helpless people. In such moments, we are reminded of the desperate need for protection and for those in power to act with justice and restraint, rather than unleashing terror.
reflection.zh: 苏丹准军事部队威胁大规模暴行的消息，呼应了古老的智慧，即邪恶的统治者对无助的人民来说，如同咆哮的狮子或冲锋的熊。在这样的时刻，我们被提醒，人们迫切需要保护，而掌权者应以公义和克制行事，而非释放恐怖。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.

title.en: Weather tracker: Heatwave expected to bring Germany and Poland to 40C
title.zh: 天气追踪：德国和波兰预计将迎来40摄氏度高温热浪

summary.en: An intense heatwave is expected to bring temperatures up to 40C in parts of central and northern Europe, including Germany and Poland. The Austrian Grand Prix has declared a heat hazard due to the dramatic rise in temperatures.
summary.zh: 预计一股强烈的热浪将使中欧和北欧部分地区（包括德国和波兰）的气温升至40摄氏度。由于气温急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛已宣布高温危险。

body.en: Austrian Grand Prix declares heat hazard as dramatic rise in temperatures forecast in central and northern Europe Temperatures are forecast to rise dramatically in parts of central and northern Europe this weekend as the intense heatwave continues . In Germany and Poland, highs up to or exceeding 40C (104F) are expected on both Saturday and Sunday, days after swathes of France experienced similar extreme temperatures. The Austrian Grand Prix, taking place this weekend in Spielberg, has declared a heat hazard , the first race to do so this season. Temperatures are expected to rise into the low 30s celsius during the race, almost 10C warmer than usual for the venue. Across Europe, the intense heat has led to severe thunderstorms. In the Sverdlovsk region of central Russia, a strong tornado was reported on the evening of 22 June. Rated a 3 out of 5 on the international Fujita scale, the twister injured 16 people and destroyed or damaged about 100 homes and businesses in the town of Kushva. Emergency services have been working on restoring power to the town. Tornadoes are not unheard of in Russia but are rare. Forecasters say they may become more common in future as the climate breaks down. Storm warnings remained in effect in the southern part of the country on Friday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 预计中欧和北欧气温将急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛宣布存在热危险 随着强烈热浪的持续，预计本周末中欧和北欧部分地区气温将大幅上升。在德国和波兰，预计周六和周日气温将达到或超过 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度），几天前法国大片地区也经历了类似的极端气温。本周末在斯皮尔伯格举行的奥地利大奖赛已宣布出现高温危险，这是本赛季第一场这样做的比赛。预计比赛期间气温将升至 30 摄氏度，比平时高出近 10 摄氏度。在整个欧洲，酷热导致了严重的雷暴天气。 6月22日晚，俄罗斯中部斯维尔德洛夫斯克地区报告出现强烈龙卷风。国际藤田等级评定为 3 级（满分 5 级），龙卷风造成 16 人受伤，并摧毁或损坏了库什瓦镇约 100 所房屋和企业。紧急服务部门一直致力于恢复该镇的供电。龙卷风在俄罗斯并非闻所未闻，但很罕见。预报员表示，随着气候的恶化，它们未来可能会变得更加普遍。周五，该国南部地区的风暴警告仍然有效。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic rise in temperatures across Europe reminds us that creation itself is experiencing distress. As the natural world groans under changing conditions, we are called to reflect on our interconnectedness with the earth and its well-being. This intense heatwave serves as a poignant reminder of the broader challenges facing our shared home.
reflection.zh: 欧洲气温的急剧上升提醒我们，受造界本身正在经历痛苦。当自然界在不断变化的环境下发出呻吟时，我们被呼召反思我们与地球及其福祉的相互关联。这场强烈热浪是对我们共同家园所面临的更广泛挑战的深刻提醒。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Xi Jinping has hosted more than a dozen leaders this year, as ‘middle powers’ look beyond the US
title.zh: 习近平今年接待了十几位领导人，‘中间力量’超越美国寻求合作

summary.en: China's leader, Xi Jinping, has hosted numerous world leaders this year, aiming to promote an alternative global order. This effort is reportedly aided by the perceived unpredictability of the United States, prompting 'middle powers' to explore new international alignments.
summary.zh: 中国领导人习近平今年接待了多位世界各国领导人，旨在推动一种替代性的全球秩序。据报道，美国的反复无常助长了这一努力，促使“中等强国”寻求新的国际结盟。

body.en: China’s leader wants to promote his alternative to the current world order, and his efforts are being assisted by a capricious US Xi Jinping meets Bangladesh’s new prime minister on Friday, the latest in a wave of world leaders to visit Beijing this year as the Chinese leader builds his influence and economic ties, and seeks to “shift the balance of power” away from the west. Xi’s meeting with Tarique Rahman comes less than two weeks after the Chinese leader welcomed Myanmar’s military chief-turned-president, Min Aung Hlaing, in Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国领导人希望推行他对当前世界秩序的替代方案，他的努力得到了反复无常的美国的协助。习近平周五会见了孟加拉国新总理，这是今年访问北京的一波世界领导人中最新的一位，中国领导人正在建立影响力和经济联系，并寻求“改变力量平衡”，远离西方。习近平与塔里克·拉赫曼的会面是在中国领导人在北京欢迎缅甸军方最高领导人、现任总统敏昂莱之后不到两周。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights how nations are drawn to leaders who articulate a clear vision for the future, especially when existing global structures seem uncertain. Proverbs 29:18 reminds us that without a guiding vision, people and nations can lose their way. This underscores the profound impact of leadership that offers a coherent path forward.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调，当现有的全球秩序显得不确定时，各国会被那些为未来描绘清晰愿景的领导人所吸引。箴言29:18提醒我们，没有指引的异象，人民和国家就会迷失方向。这突显了提供连贯前进道路的领导力所产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: UK to halve tariff-free steel imports to counter glut of cheap Chinese metal
title.zh: 英国将削减免关税钢材进口量以应对廉价中国金属过剩

summary.en: The UK government announced it will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports, doubling duties on quantities exceeding the new quota. This measure, mirrored by similar changes in EU limits, aims to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and support domestic industry.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布将把免关税钢材进口量减半，超出新配额的进口将加倍征收关税。此举与欧盟的类似调整相呼应，旨在应对全球廉价中国金属的过剩供应，并扶持本国产业。

body.en: Duty on imports outside new quota will double in move echoing similar changes in EU limits Business live – latest updates The UK government will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports allowed in an attempt to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and bolster its beleaguered local industry. New “safeguards” will be introduced on 1 July and will coincide with similar new limits being introduced by the EU for the same purposes. The UK said it and the EU had agreed an approach that reflected each other’s “highly interconnected supply chains” after months of negotiations over retaining tariff-free access between the markets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新配额之外的进口关税将翻倍，与欧盟限制的类似变化相呼应英国政府将允许的免关税钢铁进口量减半，以应对全球廉价中国金属供应过剩的问题，并提振陷入困境的当地工业。新的“保障措施”将于 7 月 1 日推出，并将与欧盟出于相同目的推出的类似新限制同时实施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often grapple with balancing economic interests and ensuring fair trade practices. Proverbs 11:1 reminds us that Yahweh values honest dealings and just measures in commerce. This principle encourages leaders to seek equitable solutions that promote integrity in global markets.
reflection.zh: 国家常在经济利益与确保公平贸易实践之间寻求平衡。箴言11:1提醒我们，雅伟看重商业中的诚实交易和公正的度量。这一原则鼓励领导者寻求公平的解决方案，以促进全球市场的诚信。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: What is China’s SpaceSail, and could it rival Elon Musk’s Starlink?
title.zh: 中国的“太空帆”是什么？它能与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争吗？

summary.en: China's state-backed SpaceSail project is developing a satellite internet constellation to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. With hundreds of satellites in low Earth orbit, the company is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries.
summary.zh: 中国国家支持的“太空帆”项目正在开发一个卫星互联网星座，旨在与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争。该公司目前在近地轨道拥有数百颗卫星，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判。

body.en: The company has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit but has state backing and is already reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries Elon Musk’s Starlink has long dominated the satellite internet industry, but a Chinese government-backed project is aiming to challenge its position. SpaceSail has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit compared with Starlink’s 10,000-plus. But the company says it now has enough satellites to begin its first commercial application, is scaling up at speed, and is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries to provide satellite internet coverage. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该公司在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星，但有国家支持，据报道已经与数十个国家进行谈判。埃隆·马斯克的星链长期以来一直主导着卫星互联网行业，但一个中国政府支持的项目旨在挑战其地位。与 Starlink 的 10,000 多颗卫星相比，SpaceSail 在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星。但该公司表示，它现在拥有足够的卫星来开始其首次商业应用，并且正在快速扩大规模，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判以提供卫星互联网覆盖。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As nations and companies embark on ambitious technological ventures like SpaceSail, it reminds us of the human drive to innovate and connect the world. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans to Yahweh, trusting that our efforts, when aligned with His purposes, will find success. This perspective can guide us in all our endeavors, from grand...
reflection.zh: 当各国和公司着手像“太空帆”这样雄心勃勃的技术项目时，这提醒我们人类创新和连接世界的动力。箴言16:3鼓励我们将我们的计划交托给雅伟，相信我们的努力，若与祂的旨意相符，必将成功。这种视角可以指导我们所有的努力，无论是宏伟的项目还是日常任务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Southeast Asia boost defense ties but avoids firm alliances
title.zh: 东南亚加强防务关系但避免建立牢固联盟

summary.en: Countries across the region are expanding defense cooperation in ways that change the South China Sea equation but fall short of a new anti-China bloc.
summary.zh: 东南亚各国正在扩大防务合作，这改变了南海局势，但尚未形成新的反华联盟。

body.en:
Countries across the region are expanding defense cooperation in ways that change the South China Sea equation but fall short of a new anti-China bloc.

For years, the South China Sea has been seen as a potential flashpoint in the intensifying geopolitical rivalry between China and the United States.   

Southeast Asian states are often presented as the smaller powers caught in the storm.

That picture is changing, however, as a new and subtle security network takes shape across the region.

It's built not around formal alliances but around access deals, missile sales, coast guard drills, intelligence-sharing talks and defense consultations.

On June 1, the Philippines and Vietnam upgraded ties to an enhanced strategic partnership and signed a memorandum on defense cooperation which commits them to high-level exchanges, strategic dialogue, information sharing and joint activities at sea.

The partnership builds on earlier coast guard arrangements, including a hotline and mechanisms to prevent incidents.

Late last month, Indian officials said that New Delhi had signed a $629 million (€555 million) deal to supply Vietnam with the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile system.

Vietnam is the second Southeast Asian buyer publicly confirmed by India, after the Philippines, which signed a $375 million contract in 2022 for three BrahMos batteries. The missiles are jointly developed by India and Russia.

Meanwhile, Japan's security relationship with the Philippines has grown quite concrete.   A Reciprocal Access Agreement entered into force last September , expanding troop deployment in each country, while this month they began talks over a new deal to share classified defense information.

In February, Australia and Indonesia signed the "Jakarta Treaty," a common security pact that commits the two governments to regular top-level consultations.

None of these agreements creates a NATO-style alliance . Together, however, they show how middle powers are trying to make unilateral pressure at sea harder and costlier.

All these countries share concerns about China and an interest in upholding the rule of law at sea and keeping the region free from coercion by great powers, Hunter Marston, director of the Southeast Asia Program at the Lowy Institute, told DW.

At the same time, they recognize — to varying degrees — the possibility that the US could scale back its commitments to regional security, which would introduce volatility and unpredictability into the prevailing balance of power, he said.

"While they don't all see eye to eye on regional security or support the United States military presence equally, now is the time for middle powers to band together to stand up for their interests. None are strong enough to do so...
body.zh: 该地区各国正在扩大防务合作，其方式改变了南海局势，但并未形成新的反华集团。 多年来，南海一直被视为中美地缘政治竞争的潜在爆发点。 东南亚国家经常被描述为陷入风暴的小国。 然而，随着整个地区新的、微妙的安全网络的形成，这种情况正在发生变化。 它不是围绕正式联盟建立的，而是围绕准入协议、导弹销售、海岸警卫队演习、情报共享会谈和国防磋商建立的。 6 月 1 日，菲律宾和越南将关系提升为强化战略伙伴关系，并签署了一份防务合作备忘录，承诺两国进行高层交往、战略对话、信息共享和海上联合活动。 该伙伴关系建立在早期海岸警卫队安排的基础上，包括热线电话和预防事件的机制。 上个月末，印度官员表示，新德里已签署一项价值 6.29 亿美元（5.55 亿欧元）的协议，向越南提供布拉莫斯超音速巡航导弹系统。 越南是继菲律宾之后印度公开确认的第二个东南亚买家，菲律宾于2022年签署了价值3.75亿美元的三块布拉莫斯电池合同。该导弹由印度和俄罗斯联合研制。 与此同时，日本与菲律宾的安全关系变得相当具体。 去年九月，一项互惠访问协议生效，扩大了两国的部队部署，本月他们开始就一项共享机密国防信息的新协议进行谈判。 今年二月，澳大利亚和印度尼西亚签署了《雅加达条约》，这是一项共同安全条约，要求两国政府定期进行高层磋商。 这些协议都没有创建北约式的联盟。然而，它们共同表明中等强国如何试图加大海上单边施压的难度和成本。 洛伊研究所东南亚项目主任亨特·马斯顿告诉德国之声，所有这些国家都对中国感到担忧，都对维护海上法治和使该地区免受大国胁迫感兴趣。 他表示，与此同时，他们在不同程度上认识到美国可能缩减其对地区安全的承诺，这将给当前的均势带来波动和不可预测性。 “虽然他们在地区安全问题上意见不一，也并不平等地支持美国的军事存在，但现在是中等强国联合起来维护自身利益的时候了。没有一个国家足够强大，可以这样做……

reflection.en: The nations of Southeast Asia are navigating complex geopolitical waters, seeking security through cooperation while carefully avoiding actions that could escalate tensions. This delicate balance reflects a desire to live at peace, as far as it depends on them, even amidst strategic disagreements. Yahweh calls us to pursue peace with all people, a principle...
reflection.zh: 东南亚各国在复杂的国际局势中寻求平衡，通过防务合作增强安全，同时谨慎避免可能加剧紧张局势的行动。这种微妙的平衡反映了他们尽力与各方和平相处的愿望，即使存在战略分歧。雅伟呼召我们尽力与所有人和睦相处，这一原则指导着人际关系和国际外交。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: North Korean soldier crosses border to South
title.zh: 朝鲜士兵越境进入韩国

summary.en: South Korea's military is investigating why a North Korean soldier crossed the heavily fortified inner-Korean border, a rare event given that most North Koreans who flee usually do so via China.
summary.zh: 韩国军方正在调查一名朝鲜士兵越过朝韩边境的原因。虽然每年有数十名朝鲜人逃离，通常经由中国，但直接向南越境的情况非常罕见。

body.zh: 韩国军方表示，正在调查这名士兵越过朝韩边境的原因。虽然每年都有数十名朝鲜人逃离（通常经由中国），但直接越境南下的情况却非常罕见。 韩国军方周三表示，一名朝鲜士兵在越过朝韩边界中部附近地区后被拘留了一夜。 首尔参谋长联席会议在给包括韩联社在内的媒体的消息中表示，“周二晚间，军方在中央前线抓获了一名朝鲜士兵，有关当局目前正在调查细节。” 韩国联合通讯社也报道称，这名士兵据信希望叛逃，但未援引消息来源。 朝鲜和韩国被戒备森严的边界隔开，边界两侧都有一个称为非军事区的特殊分界区，之后还有二级缓冲区。 尽管自 20 世纪 50 年代朝鲜半岛因战争分裂以来，已有数万名朝鲜人逃往南方，但他们通常通过陆路向北逃往邻国中国。他们往往从那里进入第三国，例如泰国，然后最终前往南方。 2024 年，即韩国统一部公布数据的最后一年，有 236 名朝鲜人抵达韩国。 不过，跨越陆地边界的叛逃情况非常罕见。边境的大部分地区森林茂密，境内布满地雷，两国军队都在各自的边境严密监视。 韩联社报道称，这是 2026 年首例此类案例。 据称，自去年六月李在明政府上台以来，已登记了四起案件。据韩联社报道，其中两次发生在 7 月，最近一次发生在 10 月。 新来者往往会被移交给情报部门进行安全检查。 一旦这一过程完成，韩国通常会授予脱北者公民身份，朝鲜认为这种做法是一种侮辱。它经常以非常严厉的措辞谈论叛逃者。 1950-53 年朝鲜战争之后，两国在技术上仍处于冻结战争状态，只签署了停战协议，没有签署和平协议。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间将我们选为 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The rare crossing of a North Korean soldier into the South highlights the profound human desire for a different life, often at great risk. Deuteronomy 10:19 reminds us to love the foreigner, recalling that Yahweh's people once experienced displacement and vulnerability. This calls us to compassion and understanding for those who seek refuge across divides.
reflection.zh: 一名朝鲜士兵罕见地越境进入韩国，这凸显了人类对不同生活的深切渴望，即使要冒巨大风险。申命记10:19提醒我们要爱护寄居的，回想雅伟的子民也曾经历过流离失所和脆弱。这呼吁我们对那些跨越分界线寻求庇护的人抱有同情和理解。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Dear You review – enjoyable Chinese romdram crosses generations as it tracks down a missing husband
title.zh: 《亲爱的你》影评：一部跨越世代、追寻失踪丈夫的感人华语爱情剧情片

summary.en: The Guardian China reviews "Dear You," a Chinese romantic drama by director Lan Hongchun. The film is a multi-generational family saga, spanning from the 1940s to the present, primarily set in Bangkok, and follows the search for a husband who disappeared in Thailand.
summary.zh: 《卫报中国》评论了导演蓝鸿春的华语爱情剧情片《亲爱的你》。这部电影是一部跨越几代人的家族传奇，故事从20世纪40年代至今，主要背景设在曼谷，讲述了一个家庭寻找在泰国失踪的丈夫的故事。

body.en: Director Lan Hongchun’s family saga feels like a good old-fashioned novel as it goes in search of a man who has disappeared in Thailand With a story that ranges from the 1940s to the present and, although mostly set in Bangkok, revolving largely around Teochew-speaking Chinese from Guangdong, this generations-spanning drama feels like a good old-fashioned novel. A romantic beach read, perhaps, the kind in which coincidences and random accidents cause misunderstandings that last for decades until the truth is finally revealed. It’s sentimental in places, sure, but there’s also a fair bit of salty, bawdy humour to cut the sweetness, lashings of period colour, and impressively naturalistic performances from a mostly non-professional cast. All that has helped to make this an unexpectedly large box-office hit in the People’s Republic last month; and for non-Chinese or Thai rom-dram aficionados anywhere, it’s well worth looking out for. As the story opens in the 21st century in the Chinese city of Shantou, octogenarian Shurou (Iap Sok-jiu) is celebrating her 87th birthday, surrounded by adoring friends, family and neighbours who revere the matriarch, not least for managing to raise three kids on her own in the 1940s and 50s. Her shifty grandson Xiaowei (Hiau-ui), however, is less of a solid citizen and, having got into debt, he decides to travel to Bangkok to find out if Shurou’s husband Zheng Musheng, not seen for decades, could help out since he’s reputed to have made a fortune out there, endowed schools all over Thailand, and had a second family after abandoning Shurou. Continue reading...
body.zh: 导演兰鸿春的家庭传奇感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说，讲述了在泰国寻找失踪男子的故事。故事范围从 20 世纪 40 年代至今，虽然主要以曼谷为背景，但主要围绕来自广东的潮州华人展开，这部跨越几代人的戏剧感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说。浪漫的海滩读物，也许是那种巧合和偶然的事故会导致持续数十年的误会，直到真相最终揭晓的类型。当然，它在某些地方是感伤的，但也有一些咸味、下流的幽默来削弱甜蜜，充满时代色彩，以及来自大多数非专业演员的令人印象深刻的自然主义表演。所有这些都使得该片上个月在中华人民共和国取得了意想不到的票房大成功。对于任何地方的非中国或泰国的浪漫剧爱好者来说，这都非常值得一看。故事发生在 21 世纪的中国汕头市，八十多岁的淑柔（叶淑如饰）正在庆祝她的 87 岁生日，周围都是崇拜这位女族长的朋友、家人和邻居，尤其是她在 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代设法独自抚养三个孩子。然而，她狡猾的孙子小伟（孝仪饰）却不是一个踏实的公民，负债累累，他决定前往曼谷，看看书柔数十年未见的丈夫郑木胜是否可以帮忙，因为他在外面发了大财，为泰国各地的学校捐款，并在抛弃书柔后有了第二个家庭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The multi-generational search for a missing husband in "Dear You" powerfully illustrates the enduring nature of family bonds. This long quest reflects the deep commitment inherent in marriage, where two become one, a union that transcends time and distance. It reminds us that true connection often calls for steadfastness, even in the face of profound...
reflection.zh: 电影《亲爱的你》中跨越几代人寻找失踪丈夫的故事，有力地展现了家庭纽带的持久性。这场漫长的寻觅反映了婚姻中固有的深刻承诺，夫妻二人成为一体，这种结合超越了时间和距离。它提醒我们，真正的连接往往需要坚韧不拔，即使面对巨大的不确定性也是如此。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: Dettol apologises after ‘toxic men’ advert sparks backlash in China
title.zh: 滴露因“有毒男性”广告在中国引发反弹后致歉

summary.en: British hygiene brand Dettol has apologized and withdrawn an advertisement in China that sparked widespread condemnation. The advert, which the company stated was intended to criticize “toxic men,” featured a man seeking a “clean and untouched” woman.
summary.zh: 英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告引发广泛谴责后，已致歉并撤回该广告。滴露公司称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，但其内容却描绘了一名男子寻找“干净纯洁”女性的情节。

body.en: British disinfectant brand withdraws advert about a man’s efforts to find a ‘clean and untouched’ woman The British hygiene brand Dettol has apologised after an advertisement released in China, which it said was intended to criticise “toxic men”, was widely condemned on social media as offensive to women. The five-minute advert for a multipurpose disinfectant, released across many online platforms at the end of May, features a man comparing his girlfriend with his former partner. Learning that his former girlfriend previously lived with someone else, the man likens their relationship to a “secondhand service”. He then tells his friends that he intends to find a “clean and untouched” woman for whom he can be the first sexual partner. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国消毒剂品牌撤回有关男性努力寻找“干净、未受影响”女性的广告英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告道歉，称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，该广告在社交媒体上受到广泛谴责，认为该广告冒犯了女性。五月底，多用途消毒剂的五分钟广告在多个在线平台上发布，其中一名男子将他的女朋友与他的前伴侣进行了比较。当得知他的前女友以前与别人住在一起时，该男子将他们的关系比作“二手服务”。然后他告诉他的朋友，他打算找一个“干净、未受污染”的女人作为他的第一个性伴侣。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The controversy surrounding Dettol's advertisement highlights the importance of recognizing the inherent dignity of every individual. When an advert reduces women to an object defined by their perceived “purity” or “untouched” status, it diminishes the profound truth that all people, male and female, are created in the image of Yahweh. This reminds us to...
reflection.zh: 滴露广告引发的争议，凸显了承认每个人固有尊严的重要性。当一个广告将女性贬低为由其所谓的“纯洁”或“未被触碰”状态来定义的客体时，它就削弱了一个深刻的真理：所有的人，无论男女，都是按雅伟的形象被造的。这提醒我们要维护他人的价值，反映出神赋予每个生命的尊贵。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher Jimmy Lai honored by DW
title.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获德国之声表彰

summary.en: Jimmy Lai, a Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher, has been honored by DW. He founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper before being sentenced to 20 years in prison. His son stated that the award signifies that those who advocate for the freedom of others are not alone.
summary.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获得德国之声表彰。他在被判处20年监禁前，创办了香港最大的亲民主报纸。他的儿子表示，这个奖项表明那些为他人自由而奋斗的人“从不孤单”。

body.en:
Before being imprisoned for 20 years, Jimmy Lai founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper. His son said the award shows that those who fight for the freedom of others "are never alone."

Arriving in Hong Kong as a penniless 12-year-old stowaway from southern China, Jimmy Lai sought only freedom and a future. At the time, Lai could never have imagined how his life would become forever intertwined with this former British colony.

"I'll sink with the ship, because this place gives me everything," said Lai in an interview about Hong Kong with DW a few months before he was taken into custody in December 2020. He was one of the first high-profile figures to be targeted under a "national security law" imposed on Hong Kong by Beijing following a crackdown on pro-democracy protests.

Beijing had said the law would restore Hong Kong "from chaos to order" after demonstrations in 2019 opposing an extradition bill morphed into massive protests against Beijing encroaching on Hong Kong's civil liberties .

Since then, the pro-democracy media mogul has spent more than 2,000 days in solitary confinement in Hong Kong's maximum-security Stanley Prison.

Lai's years-long trial ended this February, when the 78-year-old was sentenced to 20 years in prison for "colluding with foreign forces." While he had pleaded not guilty to all charges, his legal team said he will not appeal.

The sentence is the heaviest punishment handed down so far under the national security law, and Lai's trial has symbolized for many people the severe erosion of press freedom in Hong Kong as part of Beijing's broader strategy to silence critical voices.

In recognition of his defense of press freedom and freedom of speech, DW honored Jimmy Lai with this year's Freedom of Speech Award  at the annual Global Media Forum in Bonn, Germany, on Tuesday.

"While we have spoken freely in the defence of independent media, Jimmy, who founded an independent media company because he believed in the rights of the Hong Kong people to receive information, is locked away for those beliefs," Jodie Ginsberg, CEO of the Committee to Protect Journalists, said in a speech honoring Lai.

"The attacks on Apple Daily and its counterparts in Hong Kong presaged the far greater attacks on civil liberties in the years that followed. Jimmy Lai saw this and spoke out. We can honor him today not only by fighting for his freedom, but by defending the freedoms for which he was jailed."

Since 2015, the DW Freedom of Speech Award has honored journalists and human rights defenders as a way to call attention to restrictions on press freedom and concerning human rights situations around the world.

summary.en: Electric vehicles are becoming more affordable, efficient, and capable of longer distances, exceeding initial growth forecasts. China is leading this transition, with Europe and other nations rapidly advancing as well.

body.zh: 电动汽车变得越来越便宜、越来越高效，而且行驶距离比以往任何时候都更远。中国正在推动这一转型，但欧洲和其他国家正在快速追赶。 全球电动汽车 (EV) 市场的增长速度远远快于预期。短短六年内，销量增长了十倍，到 2025 年，全球电动汽车销量将达到约 2100 万辆。 中国和欧洲处于领先地位，但世界其他地区的市场也在快速增长。 中国长期以来一直在投资太阳能和风能以及电池技术——电动汽车最关键的组成部分。 得益于先进的研究和大规模生产，电动汽车电池成本大幅下降。如今，它们的成本仅为 10 年前的四分之一，而且价格还在继续下降。 中国是世界上最大的汽车市场，消费者正在从政府的产业战略中获益。自 2024 年以来，电动汽车的成本低于内燃机汽车，国家多年来一直在迅速扩大充电基础设施，而且中国的电力非常实惠。 2015年，电动汽车仅占中国新车销量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，这一比例已攀升至 61%。 电动汽车依靠电力运行并通过电缆充电。在全球范围内，三分之二的电动汽车是所谓的电池电动汽车 (BEV)，仅由电力驱动。剩下的三分之一还配备了燃气发动机，用于长途旅行时的备用——这些被称为增程电动汽车 (EREV) 或插电式混合动力电动汽车 (PHEV)。 相比之下，所谓的混合动力电动汽车 (HEV) 始终需要汽油或柴油来为其内燃机提供动力。电动机提供一些帮助，仅通过再生制动产生电力。这项技术在一定程度上降低了城市驾驶的燃油消耗，但混合动力汽车在国际统计中并未被算作电动汽车。 2018年，电动汽车仅占欧盟新车注册量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，售出的新车中近三分之一是电动汽车。 北欧处于领先地位。在挪威，现在销售的几乎所有新车都是电动汽车（99%），其次是丹麦（82%）和瑞典（65%）。该地区各国政府支持气候友好型出行，并正在扩大充电基础设施。 在英国，2026 年 4 月注册的新车中有 39% 是电动汽车，其次是德国（37%）和法国（32%）。在这三个国家，电动汽车销量与去年同月相比都翻了一番。 近年来，美国市场陷入停滞。 2023 年至 2025 年间，电动汽车占...

title.en: 'Beautiful stuff': Socceroos react as Australians pack out watch parties
title.zh: “太棒了”：澳大利亚足球队在观赛派对上座无虚席，球员们反响热烈

summary.en: Australia was captivated by "Socceroos fever" as the national football team played Paraguay in California, with many Australians gathering at watch parties to support them.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚全国上下都沉浸在“足球热”中，因为国家足球队在加利福尼亚对阵巴拉圭，许多澳大利亚人聚集在观赛派对上为他们加油。

body.en:
Fans decked out in green and gold turned out across the country to support the Socceroos as they drew with Paraguay to secure a spot in the World Cup knockout rounds.

And the Socceroos said they felt the love, when shown footage by SBS reporters of children at an Australian primary school erupting at the end of the match.

"It gives you a bit of self satisfaction that we have put a smile on all these people's faces and our journey isn't over yet so hopefully we can continue our journey for as long as possible."

Rowdy crowds packed Melbourne's Federation Square, pushing it to maximum capacity by 10am. Multiple flares were let off and a small brawl broke out but the atmosphere was mostly positive, if charged.

Roughly 7,500 people packed into the live site to watch the match, which resulted in a 0-0 draw — but was sufficient to send Australia through to the knockout round of the tournament.

While the fan base was a mixture of ages, teenagers who should have been at school for the last day of term filled Fed Square, some wearing the Australian flag as a cape.

Chants of "Aussie, Aussie, Aussie" could be heard through the crowd while beach balls were bounced over the audience.

Ducking responsibilities to support the national team was a bit of a theme on Friday, given the 12pm AEST kick- off.

Treasurer Jim Chalmers said he expected employers would be understanding if staff failed to return to work after lunch if the Socceroos won, while Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said bosses should act "with thoughts of our national interest".

Two unnamed fans told SBS News at Fed Square during the match: "It's un-Australian not to take the sick leave to get it off."

At Sydney's main viewing site, Tumbalong Park, similar numbers were seen, with many fans also on the younger side.

"I’m missing school. It's the last day of term for us, but you gotta support the Socceroos," a fan told SBS News.

While most fans were well behaved, three teenagers in Melbourne were issued penalty notices for riotous behaviour and given move-on notices. In Sydney, a 16-year-old was arrested at Tumbalong Park.

Australia managed to secure a convincing entry to the round of 32 with their clean sheet draw with Paraguay. They will face off against the second-placed team from Group G on 4 July.

Both major party leaders congratulated the team, with Opposition leader Angus Taylor referencing his famous digital blunder to congratulate the Socceroos. In 2019, he replied to his own Facebook post about extra car parking spaces at NSW railway stations with the comment: Fantastic. Great move. Well done Angus.

title.en: Melbourne beach temporarily renamed after Patrick Beach as Socceroos reach Round of 32
title.zh: 墨尔本海滩因足球队门将帕特里克·比奇表现出色而暂时更名

summary.en: Socceroos goalkeeper Patrick Beach's performance in the team's match against Paraguay has earned him a tribute back in Melbourne, with a local beach temporarily renamed in his honor.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚足球队门将帕特里克·比奇在对阵巴拉圭的比赛中表现出色，墨尔本的一处海滩因此暂时以他的名字命名，以示敬意。

body.en:
The City of Port Philip in Melbourne's south says the iconic beachfront will be renamed after Melbourne City and Socceroos goalkeeper Patrick Beach for the remainder of the national squad's FIFA World Cup 2026 campaign.

It comes after the team's 0-0 draw against Paraguay secured their spot in the knockout rounds of this year's tournament.

At 22 years old, the goalkeeper made a surprise World Cup debut for the Socceroos against Türkiye and has remained in goal for all of the side's 2026 World Cup games.
